confidence_notes: Current Kotor price indexes give a useful basis for meals, coffee, and beer. Cocktail pricing is inferred above local beer prices; wine is estimated near local beer and house-wine prices. July accommodation estimates are holistic and less certain because of seasonal demand and wide variation by location and property.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Kotor-specific price data. Accommodation reflects general July pricing for high-demand Adriatic towns such as Budva and Tivat.
